_doc: Locked flow settings. Platform nangate45 (FreePDK45 + Nangate Open Cell Library, typical corner) through OpenROAD-flow-scripts 26Q3. One set of settings per block; every candidate of a block, in both arms, uses exactly these settings. 'clock_latency_ns' is the ideal latency given to the real and the virtual IO clock (ORFS SDC style); gcd and aes keep the values ORFS ships for nangate45, the other four were measured once on the original RTL (see targets/calibration.json) before any loop ran. aes drops ORFS's SWAP_ARITH_OPERATORS/OPENROAD_HIERARCHICAL so that all six blocks are synthesized with the same ABC speed script (which buffers high-fanout nets); with SWAP_ARITH_OPERATORS ORFS uses a gate-only ABC script that leaves fanouts of 144 unbuffered and makes pre-layout timing meaningless.
